# Sternshein CPAs

- Sternshein CPAs is a two-CPA accounting firm in Los Angeles, California.
- Robert J. Sternshein and Lawrence M. Sternshein are certified public accountants.
- The office is at 2999 Overland Avenue, Suite 200, Los Angeles, CA 90064.
- They prepare individual, business, estate, and trust tax returns.
- They plan taxes, keep small business books, run payroll, and set up QuickBooks.
- They resolve IRS problems including audits, back taxes, liens, levies, and payment plans.
- They serve individuals, executives, and small business owners in Los Angeles.
- The first consultation is free.
- Call Robert Sternshein at (310) 274-0335 or Lawrence Sternshein at (310) 274-9878.
- Email Bob@SternsheinCPA.com or Larry@SternsheinCPA.com.
- Website: https://www.sternsheincpa.com/
